summary.zh: 中英双语、暗色模式的个人博客：React + TypeScript + Tailwind CSS + Vite，Markdown 渲染、GitHub 贡献图、LeetCode 刷题墙、多版本在线简历；以「脚本 + 数据驱动」的内容管线自动化维护博客 / 项目 / 简历。
summary.en: Bilingual (zh/en) personal blog with dark mode: React + TypeScript + Tailwind CSS + Vite, Markdown rendering, GitHub contribution graph, LeetCode heatmap and multi-version online resume — maintained through a script + data-driven content pipeline for posts, projects and resumes.

summary.en: Curated learning notes on algorithms, frameworks and tooling.

summary.zh: 一个涵盖多应用场景的 AI Skills 集合
summary.en: A collection of AI Skills covering multiple application scenarios

summary.zh: 在 AMD 芯片上开发的私密、以证据为基础的办公助理：导入项目参考文件与任务列表，以 FAISS + BM25 混合检索（RRF 融合排序）定位项目范围证据、评估任务进度，结合规则引擎与本地适配模型生成可审计的报告捆绑包。Llama 3.1 8B Instruct 经 ROCm 本地部署，推理全程不出本机。
summary.en: A private, evidence-based office assistant on AMD chips: imports project reference files and task lists, locates scope evidence and assesses task progress via FAISS + BM25 hybrid retrieval with RRF fusion, and produces auditable report bundles by combining a rule engine with a locally adapted model. Llama 3.1 8B Instruct runs fully on-device via ROCm — inference never leaves the machine.

title.en: Smart Construction Site · Construction safety intelligent system

summary.zh: 面向施工安全的可控智能体：业务闭环（检出 → 派发 → 整改（本人 + 照片）→ 验收/驳回 → 逾期越级催办 → 全程审计），不止于「模型能检出」；自研 Plan-and-Execute 受限内核，LLM 仅在规划与汇总出场、步数 + 墙钟双闸强制收敛；Prompt 注入三重护栏（工具白名单、参数 schema 二次校验、权限作用域由代码注入）；YOLOv8-ONNX 无 GPU 端侧推理；判定与生成分离——风险等级查表，LLM 永不进定级。
summary.en: A controllable agent for construction safety: full business loop (detect → dispatch → rectify → verify/reject → escalate overdue → end-to-end audit); a self-built constrained Plan-and-Execute kernel where the LLM only plans and summarizes under step + wall-clock dual deadlines; three-layer prompt-injection guardrails (tool allowlist, arg-schema validation, code-injected permission scope); GPU-free edge vision via YOLOv8-ONNX; rule-table risk grading — the LLM never decides severity.

summary.zh: 基于 LangGraph 的治理型医疗问答智能体：混合检索（向量 + BM25 + RRF 融合）、知识图谱多跳推理、三层记忆体系（短期上下文 / 向量事件记忆 / 结构化画像）、角色隔离的健康档案访问控制、确定性反思闭环与答案级合规闸门。RAGAS 评测：context_recall / context_precision 均 1.00，faithfulness 0.95，answer_relevancy 0.92。
summary.en: Governance-oriented medical Q&A agent built on LangGraph: hybrid retrieval (vector + BM25 with RRF fusion), knowledge-graph multi-hop reasoning, a three-tier memory system (short-term context / vector event memory / structured profile), role-isolated access control for health records, deterministic reflection loops and an answer-level compliance gate. RAGAS: context_recall & context_precision 1.00, faithfulness 0.95, answer_relevancy 0.92.
